records.text: Shmuley Boteach met with Anonymous Source #7 (Ep d7VsbEIWkP8)

appearances.snippet: Both of you walked up together, and you said, 'Are you Rabbi Shmuley?' And I said yes. Then you said, 'I'm a big fan. Can I do a video?' I said, 'I'm on a call.' I begged you to wait.
